guidance: One core message. Outline sections should each argue one point with evidence. Assets and distribution need enough detail to produce and publish. Do not draft the full content unless asked—brief for production.

outline.title: Overview
outline.guidance: Audience and core message for the piece.

children.title: Section
children.guidance: Title each instance with the section heading, not "Section".

children.title: Supporting Evidence
children.guidance: Data, quotes, or examples to include.

children.title: Creative Asset
children.guidance: Title each instance with the asset name, e.g. "Hero image".

children.title: Description
children.guidance: What to create and any constraints (size, tone, must-include).

outline.title: Distribution
outline.guidance: Where and when the content publishes.

children.title: Channel
children.guidance: Title each instance with the platform, not "Channel".
